blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nxled made history with its first-ever semifinals appearance in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. The Chameleons remained dominant in six games and became the first team to advance after a 27-25, 25-22, 26-24 sweep of sister Akari on Thursday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Brooke Van Sickle led another balanced attack with 10 points, while MJ Phillips, Myla Pablo, and EJ Laure-Cariño added nine each, with Gel Cayuna dishing out 17 excellent sets on top of three points.
